utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, I can check that for you — I heard it’s happening this week, and I can tell you where folks are dropping things off if you want.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — that’d be great. If you can share the drop-off spot, I can help keep folks pointed the right way.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll check the drop-off spot and let you know right away. Folks are really pitching in, so it should be easy to point them the right way.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: It’s for neighborhood repairs—if you’ve got anything broken or urgent, I can help flag it and pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That would be a big help — could you reach out to the tool folks and anyone who can lend a hand after 3:30? I’ll send over the repair drive details soon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing — I’ll reach out to the tool folks and anyone who can help after 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out for those and pass the word along while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, do we still need the cordless drill and extra screwdrivers? And once you know the drop-off spot, can you let me know too?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep — cordless drill and extra screwdrivers are still on the list, and I’ll let you know the drop-off spot as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Leo — 3:30 works for me after pickup. Just send me the repair drive details and I’ll coordinate around school times.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll send the repair drive details and plan to swing by around 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks, Leo. I’ll be there after pickup and keep it lined up with school times.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Pia — I’m still set for the front porch this afternoon with the donated tools. Just let me know if the list changes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam — the porch plan still works for me, but I’m checking the pickup time and who’s handling the rest so I can keep it straight. If anything changes on the tool list, let me know right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Will do, Pia — I’ll let you know right away if the tool list changes. Thanks for keeping it straight; I’ll be at the front porch this afternoon with the donated tools.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — we still need a cordless drill and a few extra screwdrivers. If you’ve got the location and time, I’ll keep that straight too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check what’s still needed and let everyone know the next step. If anything changes, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an ear out. Just let me know the location and time when you have it, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll swing by late and help load the last bits once your list is ready.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds fine, Dane. Just send me the list and timing, and I’ll keep everything ready.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do — I’ll wait for Cleo’s list and then swing by late to help load up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Nell — if you need any tools for the repair drive, I’ve got a few you can borrow.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — that’d help a lot. If you’ve got any extra tools, I’d be grateful to borrow them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Nell — I can bring by the screwdriver set and a few other handy tools for the repair drive. Just tell me what you need most.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t checked the repair drive details yet—what exactly needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m not totally up to speed either, but I know we’re still waiting on the next update. If you hear anything new, just let me know and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — I’ll wait for the update and let you know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking what we’ve got on hand and what’s still needed for the repair drive. What kinds of repairs are we covering?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m not sure of every item yet, but I can spread the word and ask around for what people can bring. Want me to check with the neighbors and send you a quick list?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, please—that’d be a big help. Ask for household repair supplies like tape, screws, patch kits, and any extra tools, and I’ll keep track of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — that’d be really helpful. A quick list of what people still need would be great.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure — we still need a cordless drill and a few extra screwdrivers. If you give me the repair drive location and time, I’ll note those too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Absolutely — I’ll send the location and time. Thanks, Opal, and I’ll keep an eye out for a cordless drill and extra screwdrivers too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa — later is better. I’ll keep it discreet and let you know if I need anything small.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Uli — thank you. Just send me a quick note if anything comes up, and I’ll keep everything on the Sunday community center list.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa — I appreciate that. I’ll keep it quiet and send a note if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still on board, but I need the pickup time and tool list nailed down first. Once we know who’s bringing what, I can help get it organized.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Pia — I’ll pin down the pickup time and tool list first, then I’ll loop you in so you can help organize it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me — just send me the pickup time and who’s bringing which tools, and I’ll help sort the rest.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense — I can help check what’s already on hand if you want. What’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still checking what’s needed for the repair drive, and I’ll pass it along once I know. If anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik — just let me know when you’ve got the list. I can help check what we already have here.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still not sure what’s on the list—can you tell me what the drive still needs?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll connect everyone and send the repair drive details around 3:30 so you can see what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — I’ll look for the details around 3:30 and check what’s still needed before I help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s starting to look lively already — folks are bringing tools, paint, and a few snacks too. If you want, I can keep an ear out and tell you what else comes in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nice, that sounds great — just keep me posted on what people bring in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll keep you posted. So far it’s tools, paint, and snacks, and I’ll let you know if anything else turns up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. I’ll send Faye the details now.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just let me know if you need anything else for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. I’ll let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. If you can help spread the word or check in with neighbors, that would be great.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — Sunday at the community center. I’ll keep that straight and can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Opal — thank you. If you hear of any urgent repairs, just send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. Later is better — I’ll have it ready and keep it discreet.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — I might miss a few updates, but I’ll watch for your message and help if I can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I’ll message you when it’s ready, and I appreciate you keeping an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I can spread the word around the block and see who can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks — I’ll pass that along while I’m out. A cordless drill and a few extra screwdrivers, got it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll let folks know we need a cordless drill and extra screwdrivers, and I’ll see who can help out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: We still need a cordless drill and a few extra screwdrivers. If you’ve got the repair drive time and place, I can keep that straight too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that — I’ll bring a cordless drill and a few screwdrivers if I can, and I’ll keep the time and place straight too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam — that helps a lot. I’m still a bit fuzzy, so if you remember the time and place, please remind me again.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking what we’ve got on hand and what’s still needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Cleo — that’s really helpful. I’ll be there after pickup around 3:30, and I’m happy to help coordinate around the school times.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks, Faye — I’ll make a quick supply list and have it ready by then.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m in, but I want to confirm the timing and pickup details first. Who’s handling the flyers, and where’s the drop-off spot?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can handle the flyers, and the drop-off spot is by the community center entrance. I’ll be there around 3.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — so you’ve got the flyers, the drop-off is at the community center entrance, and you’ll be there around 3?
